Reaching the comet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The violet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the spiral. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
